text: Home by myself, feeling like I'm locked in a cell. Mind trapped in this box, watching what they're trying to sell. Not buying in or denying that we out for ourselves. Marginalized by large enterprises, targets of lies and bargains made to clog up your eyes. Carving the time slots, minds robbed, making it hard to decide who's on my side. Lives sewn, woven into our eyes. Lives are being stolen and no one's making it right. A systematic oscillation controls whole population. Joe, this nation is sold out from under our nose. It's no wonder so many police are patrolling my street.
